dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: non-germinal-center B-cell (non-GCB) phenotype by the Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Non-GCB/activated B-cell-like immunophenotype (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1 positive)

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: above and below the diaphragm, with splenic involvement (IIIS)
stage_spleen_nodal.note: Spleen treated as stage III (IIIS) implicitly; no explicit statement that spleen is lymphatic.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms present (fever, drenching night sweats); largest mass 11.0 cm (bulky)

mol_de_not_dh.quote: This is DLBCL, NOS, not double-hit or triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.note: Correct intermediate category but miscalculated score as 2 (omits stage III point) rather than 3.

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Curative-intent Pola-R-CHP: polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg, rituximab 375 mg/m2

tx_pola_preferred.quote: If polatuzumab is not available or not covered, R-CHOP every 21 days for 6 cycles is the standard alternative
tx_pola_preferred.note: Pola-R-CHP preferred with R-CHOP alternative, but no mention of greater benefit in non-GCB disease.

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: I would not give consolidative radiation upfront in the absence of residual disease.
tx_isrt_residual_bulk.note: Implies RT possible with residual disease but never plans ISRT for PET-positive residual bulk; Deauville 5 goes to salvage.

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use DA-EPOCH-R routinely

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily after baseline HBV DNA and continue for 12 months after the last rituximab dose
hbv_prophylaxis.note: Timing before first rituximab is implied (pre-cycle-1 workup) rather than stated explicitly.

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily after baseline HBV DNA and continue for 12 months after the last rituximab dose, with periodic HBV DNA monitoring
hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.note: Baseline and serial HBV DNA ordered; ALT/LFT monitoring not explicitly stated.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give routine intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment FDG PET-CT approximately 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted by Lugano 2014/Deauville 5-point criteria.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4 is equivocal; I will repeat PET in 6-12 weeks or biopsy. Deauville 5 or biopsy-proven residual disease is refractory/progressive disease
resp_ds45_biopsy.note: Biopsy offered for DS4 but DS5 alone triggers salvage without biopsy.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: start allopurinol 300 mg daily before chemotherapy, give aggressive intravenous hydration

sup_gcsf.quote: Give pegfilgrastim 6 mg subcutaneously on day 2 as primary febrile-neutropenia prophylaxis.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: with normal LVEF and organ function; he is a candidate for full-dose curative-intent anthracycline therapy

fit_full_dose.quote: he is a candidate for full-dose curative-intent anthracycline therapy

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Hepatitis B virus DNA level (anti-HBc positive, HBsAg negative) to finalize entecavir prophylaxis and monitoring.
